name: jandi-mcp

tools.name: generate_webhook_script
tools.description: Generate a script to send messages via Jandi webhooks. Supports both Incoming and Team Incoming webhook types in Python, Node.js, curl, and bash.

language.description: Programming language for the generated script

webhookType.description: Webhook type: 'incoming' (channel message) or 'team-incoming' (personal message). Default is 'incoming'

color.description: Hex color code for the message (e.g., '#FF0000')

imageUrl.description: Image URL for the message attachment

teamId.description: Jandi team ID (required for team-incoming webhook type)

email.description: Comma-separated recipient emails (required for team-incoming webhook type)

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a basic text message to Jandi channel via Incoming Webhook

message.description: The message text to send to Jandi

token.description: Jandi webhook token (32-character hexadecimal string). If not provided, will use tokenAlias or default token

tokenAlias.description: Token alias from configuration (e.g., 'default', 'dev', 'prod'). If not provided, will use 'default'

tools.name: send_rich_message
tools.description: Send a rich message with color and attachments to Jandi channel via Incoming Webhook

message.description: The main message text to send to Jandi

color.description: Hex color code for the message attachment (e.g., '#FF0000' for red). Default is Jandi's default color

connectInfo.description: Array of additional information sections with optional title, description, and image URL

token.description: Jandi webhook token (32-character hexadecimal string). If not provided, will use tokenAlias or default token

tokenAlias.description: Token alias from configuration (e.g., 'default', 'dev', 'prod'). If not provided, will use 'default'

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Test Jandi Incoming Webhook connection by sending various test messages

token.description: Jandi webhook token to test (32-character hexadecimal string). If not provided, will use tokenAlias or default token

tokenAlias.description: Token alias from configuration to test (e.g., 'default', 'dev', 'prod'). If not provided, will use 'default'

testType.description: Type of test to perform: 'basic' (simple message), 'rich' (rich message), 'all' (comprehensive test). Default is 'basic'

tools.name: validate_token
tools.description: Validate a Jandi Incoming Webhook token by sending a test message

token.description: Jandi webhook token to validate (32-character hexadecimal string). If not provided, will use tokenAlias or default token

tokenAlias.description: Token alias from configuration to validate (e.g., 'default', 'dev', 'prod'). If not provided, will use 'default'

tools.name: generate_outgoing_handler
tools.description: Generate a server handler for Jandi Outgoing Webhook. Creates ready-to-run code for receiving and responding to Jandi outgoing webhook events.

framework.description: Server framework to generate the handler for: 'express' (Node.js), 'fastapi' (Python), 'flask' (Python)

verificationToken.description: Verification token to validate incoming requests from Jandi. If provided, the handler will verify the token.

handlerLogic.description: Custom handler logic description. Default generates an echo bot that responds with the received message.

tools.name: simulate_outgoing_payload
tools.description: Generate a simulated Jandi Outgoing Webhook payload JSON for testing your webhook handler server. Useful for local development and testing.

webhookType.description: Type of outgoing webhook: 'outgoing' (standard) or 'team-outgoing' (team). Default is 'outgoing'

text.description: The message text that triggered the webhook

keyword.description: The keyword that triggered the outgoing webhook. Default is 'test'

teamName.description: Team name for the payload. Default is 'TestTeam'

roomName.description: Chat room name for the payload. Default is 'TestRoom'

writerName.description: Writer name for the payload. Default is 'TestUser'

writerEmail.description: Writer email for the payload. Default is 'test@example.com'

tools.name: validate_outgoing_response
tools.description: Validate a Jandi Outgoing Webhook response format. Checks body length, color format, connectInfo structure, and total size limits.

body.description: The response body text to validate

connectInfo.description: Array of connectInfo sections to validate

tools.name: send_team_message
tools.description: Send a text message to specific team member(s) via Jandi Team Incoming Webhook. Messages are sent as personal messages to the specified email addresses.

email.description: Comma-separated email addresses of recipients (max 100). e.g., 'user1@example.com,user2@example.com'

teamId.description: Jandi team ID. Required if not using tokenAlias

token.description: Jandi team webhook token. Required if not using tokenAlias

tokenAlias.description: Team token alias from configuration (e.g., 'sales'). Maps to JANDI_TEAM_ID_{alias} and JANDI_TEAM_TOKEN_{alias} env vars

tools.name: send_team_rich_message
tools.description: Send a rich message with color and attachments to specific team member(s) via Jandi Team Incoming Webhook

message.description: The main message text to send

color.description: Hex color code for the message (e.g., '#FF0000'). Default is Jandi's default color

connectInfo.description: Array of additional information sections with optional title, description, and image URL

teamId.description: Jandi team ID. Required if not using tokenAlias

token.description: Jandi team webhook token. Required if not using tokenAlias

tools.name: validate_team_token
tools.description: Validate a Jandi Team Incoming Webhook token by testing the endpoint

teamId.description: Jandi team ID. Required if not using tokenAlias

token.description: Jandi team webhook token. Required if not using tokenAlias

tokenAlias.description: Team token alias from configuration (e.g., 'sales'). Maps to JANDI_TEAM_ID_{alias} and JANDI_TEAM_TOKEN_{alias} env vars
